Failure to do so may cause the latch to spring back and damage the graphics card or slot if pulled out by force.

GPUs featuring an overclocking button may conflict with the adjustable structure of the GPU support bracket. Please remove the overclocking button prior to installation to avoid interference. GPUs equipped with three full-size DisplayPorts may contact the slot when the mount is installed at a slight angle.

Compatibility with Most ATX Cases: Designed to fit cases supporting ATX motherboards, this GPU kit requires at least 6 PCIe slots for standard vertical mounting and 7 slots for tilted configurations, ensuring broad compatibility with modern builds.
